title: Daily Duas of the Holy Month of Ramadan

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 1
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ صِيَامِي فِيهِ صِيَامَ الصَّائِمِينَ وَقِيَامِي فِيهِ قِيَامَ الْقَائِمِينَ وَنَبِّهْنِي فِيهِ عَنْ نَوْمَةِ الْغَافِلِينَ وَهَبْ لِي جُرْمِي فِيهِ يَا إِلَهَ الْعَالَمِينَ وَاعْفُ عَنِّي يَا عَافِياً عَنِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day make my fasts the fasts of those who fast (sincerely), and my standing up in prayer of those who stand up in prayer (obediently), awaken me in it from the sleep of the heedless, and forgive me my sins, O God of the worlds, and forgive me, O one who forgives the sinners.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 2
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قَرِّبْنِي فِيهِ إِلَى مَرْضَاتِكَ وَجَنِّبْنِي فِيهِ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ وَنَقِمَاتِكَ وَوَفِّقْنِي فِيهِ لِقِرَاءَةِ آيَاتِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day take me closer towards Your pleasure, keep me away from Your anger and punishment, grant me the opportunity to recite Your verses (of the Qur'an), by Your mercy, O the most Merciful.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 3
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي فِيهِ الذِّهْنَ وَالتَّنْبِيهَ وَبَاعِدْنِي فِيهِ مِنَ السَّفَاهَةِ وَالتَّمْوِيهِ وَاجْعَلْ لِي نَصِيباً مِنْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ تُنْزِلُ فِيهِ بِجُودِكَ يَا أَجْوَدَ الْأَجْوَدِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day grant me intelligence and alertness, keep me away from foolishness and (deceptive) pretension, and make me share in every good that You send down on this day, by Your generosity, O the most Generous of the generous.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 4
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قَوِّنِي فِيهِ عَلَى إِقَامَةِ أَمْرِكَ وَأَذِقْنِي فِيهِ حَلَاوَةَ ذِكْرِكَ وَأَوْزِعْنِي فِيهِ لِأَدَاءِ شُكْرِكَ بِكَرَمِكَ وَاحْفَظْنِي فِيهِ بِحِفْظِكَ وَسَتْرِكَ يَا أَبْصَرَ النَّاظِرِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day strengthen me to observe Your command, make me taste the sweetness of Your remembrance, enable me through Your graciousness that I give thanks to You, protect me with Your protection and covering (of faults), O the most discerning of those who see.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 5
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي فِيهِ مِنَ الْمُسْتَغْفِرِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي فِيهِ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ الْقَانِتِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي فِيهِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَائِكَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ بِرَأْفَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day place me among those who seek forgiveness, place me among Your righteous and obedient servants, and place me among Your close friends, by Your kindness, O the most Merciful.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 6
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَخْذُلْنِي فِيهِ لِتَعَرُّضِ مَعْصِيَتِكَ وَلَا تَضْرِبْنِي بِسِيَاطِ نَقِمَتِكَ وَزَحْزِحْنِي فِيهِ مِنْ مُوجِبَاتِ سَخَطِكَ بِمَنِّكَ وَأَيَادِيكَ يَا مُنْتَهَى رَغْبَةِ الرَّاغِبِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day do not abase me by (my) disobeying You, and do not strike me with the whip of Your punishments, keep me away from the causes of Your anger, by Your kindness and Your power, O the ultimate wish of those who desire.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 7
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي فِيهِ عَلَى صِيَامِهِ وَقِيَامِهِ وَجَنِّبْنِي فِيهِ مِنْ هَفَوَاتِهِ وَآثَامِهِ وَارْزُقْنِي فِيهِ ذِكْرَكَ بِدَوَامِهِ بِتَوْفِيقِكَ يَا هَادِيَ الْمُضِلِّينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day help me with its fasting and prayers, and keep me away from mistakes and sins of the day, grant me that I remember You continuously through the day, by Your assistance, O the Guide of those who stray.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 8
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي فِيهِ رَحْمَةَ الْأَيْتَامِ وَإِطْعَامَ الطَّعَامِ وَإِفْشَاءَ السَّلَامِ وَصُحْبَةَ الْكِرَامِ بِطَوْلِكَ يَا مَلْجَأَ الْآمِلِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day grant me mercy upon the orphans, feeding (the hungry), spreading (the greeting of) peace, and keeping company with the noble, by Your favor, O the refuge of those who hope.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 9
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِي فِيهِ نَصِيباً مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ الْوَاسِعَةِ وَاهْدِنِي فِيهِ لِبَرَاهِينِكَ السَّاطِعَةِ وَخُذْ بِنَاصِيَتِي إِلَى مَرْضَاتِكَ الْجَامِعَةِ بِمَحَبَّتِكَ يَا أَمَلَ الْمُشْتَاقِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day grant me a share from Your vast mercy, guide me to Your shining proofs, and take me by my forelock to Your all-embracing pleasure through Your love, O the hope of those who yearn.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 10
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي فِيهِ مِنَ الْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ عَلَيْكَ وَاجْعَلْنِي فِيهِ مِنَ الْفَائِزِينَ لَدَيْكَ وَاجْعَلْنِي فِيهِ مِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ إِلَيْكَ بِإِحْسَانِكَ يَا غَايَةَ الطَّالِبِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day make me among those who rely upon You, make me among those who succeed (in attaining) Your nearness, and make me among those brought near to You, by Your goodness, O the ultimate goal of those who seek.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 11
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إِلَيَّ فِيهِ الْإِحْسَانَ وَكَرِّهْ إِلَيَّ فِيهِ الْفُسُوقَ وَالْعِصْيَانَ وَحَرِّمْ عَلَيَّ فِيهِ السَّخَطَ وَالنِّيرَانَ بِعَوْنِكَ يَا غِيَاثَ الْمُسْتَغِيثِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day make good deeds beloved to me, make wickedness and disobedience abhorrent to me, and forbid Your anger and the Fire upon me, by Your help, O the helper of those who seek help.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 12
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ زَيِّنِّي فِيهِ بِالسِّتْرِ وَالْعَفَافِ وَاسْتُرْنِي فِيهِ بِلِبَاسِ الْقُنُوعِ وَالْكَفَافِ وَاحْمِلْنِي فِيهِ عَلَى الْعَدْلِ وَالْإِنْصَافِ وَآمِنِّي فِيهِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَا أَخَافُ بِعِصْمَتِكَ يَا عِصْمَةَ الْخَائِفِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day adorn me with modesty and chastity, clothe me with the garment of contentment and sufficiency, make me adhere to justice and fairness, and make me safe from all that I fear, by Your protection, O the protector of the fearful.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 13
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ طَهِّرْنِي فِيهِ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ وَالْأَقْذَارِ وَصَبِّرْنِي فِيهِ عَلَى كَائِنَاتِ الْأَقْدَارِ وَوَفِّقْنِي فِيهِ لِلتُّقَى وَصُحْبَةِ الْأَبْرَارِ بِعَوْنِكَ يَا قُرَّةَ عَيْنِ الْمَسَاكِينِ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day purify me from filth and impurity, make me patient over the decrees of destiny, and grant me the success to piety and the company of the righteous, by Your help, O the delight of the eyes of the destitute.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 14
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِي فِيهِ بِالْعَثَرَاتِ وَأَقِلْنِي فِيهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا وَالْهَفَوَاتِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْنِي فِيهِ غَرَضاً لِلْبَلَايَا وَالْآفَاتِ بِعِزَّتِكَ يَا عِزَّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day do not take me to task for slips, lessen my mistakes and errors, do not make me a target of afflictions and troubles, by Your honor, O the honor of the Muslims.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 15
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي فِيهِ طَاعَةَ الْخَاشِعِينَ وَاشْرَحْ فِيهِ صَدْرِي بِإِنَابَةِ الْمُخْبِتِينَ بِأَمَانِكَ يَا أَمَانَ الْخَائِفِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day grant me the obedience of the humble, expand my chest through the repentance of the penitent, by Your security, O the safety of the fearful.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 16
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَفِّقْنِي فِيهِ لِمُوَافَقَةِ الْأَبْرَارِ وَجَنِّبْنِي فِيهِ مُرَافَقَةَ الْأَشْرَارِ وَآوِنِي فِيهِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ إِلَى دَارِ الْقَرَارِ بِإِلَهِيَّتِكَ يَا إِلَهَ الْعَالَمِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day grant me success in agreeing with the righteous, keep me away from keeping company with the wicked, and give me refuge by Your mercy in the abode of permanence, by Your divinity, O God of the worlds.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 17
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيهِ لِصَالِحِ الْأَعْمَالِ وَاقْضِ لِي فِيهِ الْحَوَائِجَ وَالْآمَالَ يَا مَنْ لَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى التَّفْسِيرِ وَالسُّؤَالِ يَا عَالِماً بِمَا فِي صُدُورِ الْعَالَمِينَ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day guide me to righteous deeds, fulfil my needs and hopes, O One who does not need explanations nor questions, O One who knows what is in the chests of the (people of the) world. Bless Muhammad and his family, the Pure.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 18
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ نَبِّهْنِي فِيهِ لِبَرَكَاتِ أَسْحَارِهِ وَنَوِّرْ فِيهِ قَلْبِي بِضِيَاءِ أَنْوَارِهِ وَخُذْ بِكُلِّ أَعْضَائِي إِلَى اتِّبَاعِ آثَارِهِ بِنُورِكَ يَا مُنَوِّرَ قُلُوبِ الْعَارِفِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day awaken me to the blessings of its early mornings, illuminate my heart with the brightness of its lights, let every part of my body follow its effects, by Your light, O the illuminator of the hearts of those who know.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 19
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَفِّرْ فِيهِ حَظِّي مِنْ بَرَكَاتِهِ وَسَهِّلْ سَبِيلِي إِلَى خَيْرَاتِهِ وَلَا تَحْرِمْنِي قَبُولَ حَسَنَاتِهِ يَا هَادِياً إِلَى الْحَقِّ الْمُبِينِ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day increase my share of its blessings, make easy my way to its goodness, and do not deprive me of the acceptance of its good deeds, O the Guide to the manifest truth.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 20
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي فِيهِ أَبْوَابَ الْجِنَانِ وَأَغْلِقْ عَنِّي فِيهِ أَبْوَابَ النِّيرَانِ وَوَفِّقْنِي فِيهِ لِتِلَاوَةِ الْقُرْآنِ يَا مُنْزِلَ السَّكِينَةِ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day open for me the doors of the Gardens, lock the doors of the Fire against me, and grant me the success to recite the Qur'an, O the One who sends down tranquility into the hearts of the believers.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 21
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِي فِيهِ إِلَى مَرْضَاتِكَ دَلِيلاً وَلَا تَجْعَلْ لِلشَّيْطَانِ فِيهِ عَلَيَّ سَبِيلاً وَاجْعَلِ الْجَنَّةَ لِي مَنْزِلاً وَمَقِيلاً يَا قَاضِيَ حَوَائِجِ الطَّالِبِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day show me the way to Your pleasure, do not give Satan any authority over me, make Paradise an abode and a resting place for me, O the One who fulfills the requests of the needy.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 22
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي فِيهِ أَبْوَابَ فَضْلِكَ وَأَنْزِلْ عَلَيَّ فِيهِ بَرَكَاتِكَ وَوَفِّقْنِي فِيهِ لِمُوجِبَاتِ مَرْضَاتِكَ وَأَسْكِنِّي فِيهِ بُحْبُوحَاتِ جَنَّاتِكَ يَا مُجِيبَ دَعْوَةِ الْمُضْطَرِّينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day open for me the doors of Your grace, send down upon me its blessings, help me towards the causes of Your mercy, and place me in the comforts of Paradise, O the One who answers the call of the distressed.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 23
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْنِي فِيهِ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَطَهِّرْنِي فِيهِ مِنَ الْعُيُوبِ وَامْتَحِنْ قَلْبِي فِيهِ بِتَقْوَى الْقُلُوبِ يَا مُقِيلَ عَثَرَاتِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day wash me from sins, purify me from faults, test my heart with the piety of hearts, O the One who overlooks the shortcomings of the sinners.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 24
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فِيهِ مَا يُرْضِيكَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِمَّا يُؤْذِيكَ وَأَسْأَلُكَ التَّوْفِيقَ فِيهِ لِأَنْ أُطِيعَكَ وَلَا أَعْصِيَكَ يَا جَوَادَ السَّائِلِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day I ask You for what pleases You, and I seek refuge in You from what harms You, and I ask You for the success to obey You and not disobey You, O the Generous to those who ask.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 25
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي فِيهِ مُحِبّاً لِأَوْلِيَائِكَ وَمُعَادِياً لِأَعْدَائِكَ مُسْتَنّاً بِسُنَّةِ خَاتَمِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ يَا عَاصِمَ قُلُوبِ النَّبِيِّينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day make me a friend to Your friends and an enemy to Your enemies, following the way of Your last Prophet, O the Guardian of the hearts of the Prophets.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 26
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ سَعْيِي فِيهِ مَشْكُوراً وَذَنْبِي فِيهِ مَغْفُوراً وَعَمَلِي فِيهِ مَقْبُولاً وَعَيْبِي فِيهِ مَسْتُوراً يَا أَسْمَعَ السَّامِعِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day make my efforts worthy of appreciation, my sins forgiven, my deeds accepted, my flaws concealed, O the best of those who hear.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 27
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي فِيهِ فَضْلَ لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ وَصَيِّرْ أُمُورِي فِيهِ مِنَ الْعُسْرِ إِلَى الْيُسْرِ وَاقْبَلْ مَعَاذِيرِي وَحُطَّ عَنِّي الذَّنْبَ وَالْوِزْرَ يَا رَءُوفاً بِعِبَادِهِ الصَّالِحِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day bestow on me the blessings of Laylatul Qadr, change my affairs from (being) difficult to (being) easy, accept my apologies, and decrease for me [my] sins and burdens, O the Compassionate with His righteous servants.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 28
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَفِّرْ حَظِّي فِيهِ مِنَ النَّوَافِلِ وَأَكْرِمْنِي فِيهِ بِإِحْضَارِ الْمَسَائِلِ وَقَرِّبْ فِيهِ وَسِيلَتِي إِلَيْكَ مِنْ بَيْنِ الْوَسَائِلِ يَا مَنْ لَا يَشْغَلُهُ إِلْحَاحُ الْمُلِحِّينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day increase my share of the optional (prayers), honor me by presenting my requests (before You), bring my means closer to You among all means, O the One who is not preoccupied by the persistence of the beseechers.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 29
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ غَشِّنِي فِيهِ بِالرَّحْمَةِ وَارْزُقْنِي فِيهِ التَّوْفِيقَ وَالْعِصْمَةَ وَطَهِّرْ قَلْبِي مِنْ غَيَاهِبِ التُّهْمَةِ يَا رَحِيماً بِعِبَادِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day cover me with mercy, grant me success and protection (from sins), purify my heart from the darkness of false accusations, O the Merciful to His believing servants.

duas.title: Ramadan Dua of Day 30
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ صِيَامِي فِيهِ بِالشُّكْرِ وَالْقَبُولِ عَلَى مَا تَرْضَاهُ وَيَرْضَاهُ الرَّسُولُ مُحْكَمَةً فُرُوعُهُ بِالْأُصُولِ بِحَقِّ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
duas.translation: O Allah, on this day make my fasting accepted with thanks and acceptance in accordance with what pleases You and pleases the Messenger, with its branches firmly attached to its roots, by the right of our master Muhammad and his pure family; and all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.
